description: L'importance de l'encrassement dans le port d'Ostende en 1964 is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vlaams Instituut voor Zee. Overview of the different taxa that cause fouling in the busiest part of the Ostend harbour, namely the ferry wharfs. The data were digitized by VLIZ from the original report: Persoone, G. (1965). Sur l'importance du fouling dans le port d'Ostende en 1964. G. Persoone: Gent. 6 pp. Coverage: Vlaams Instituut voor Zee. The portal shows the English title as "The importance of fouling in the port of Ostend in 1964" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vlaams Instituut voor Zee. Its keywords include Biodiversität, biodiversiteit, biodiversity, biodiversité. The listing shows 1 download or service links in DWCA. The listing shows 2024-08-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
